title: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:2:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 6(2) (Verification of Emission Standards for Lifting Equipment, etc.) According to Article 14(2) of the Act, the head of the local Marine and Fisheries Agency may request the port operator to submit the following materials:
1. Engine output and manufacturing year of lifting equipment
2. Materials that can verify whether the lifting equipment meets the emission standards specified in Annex 4 (e.g., exhaust gas emission standards for lifting equipment, in the case of imported engines, emission standards of the manufacturing country at the time of manufacture)
